note: Reel 27: You're the Target. Episode 5 of 'You're the test subject'. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart). The officer (o01-o10) and the mother (m01, m02) are cast and placed from the cast reads (Kokoro is deterministic, so a cast read is take t1). Script 4, after three reviews (two story, one facts and care). m01h and m02h are the mother's line in Hindi (text = romanised for the scorer, text_kokoro = Devanagari), only for an A/B the user may ask for. ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.
